pikachu-electro-ball.name: Electro Ball
pikachu-electro-ball.description: Bond skill: hurls an electric orb at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 75, scales with Speed).

pikachu-electroweb.name: Electroweb
pikachu-electroweb.description: Bond skill: an electric net on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 70); Slows 1 turn.

pikachu-volt-tackle.name: Volt Tackle
pikachu-volt-tackle.description: Bond skill: a fully charged tackle (Power 100, Attack) that Paralyses the foe for 1 turn.

pikachu-lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
pikachu-lightning-rod.description: Draws electricity in: its Electric moves deal 15% more damage.

pikachu-nimble-paws.name: Nimble Paws
pikachu-nimble-paws.description: Regains 1 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

pikachu-iron-tail.name: Iron Tail
pikachu-iron-tail.description: New skill: a steel-hard tail strike (Power 70) that leaves the foe Exposed for 1 turn.

pikachu-agility.name: Agility
pikachu-agility.description: New skill: relaxes and lightens its body; it is Hasted for 2 turns.

pikachu-nimble-escape.name: Nimble Escape
pikachu-nimble-escape.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

pikachu-overcharge.name: Overcharge
pikachu-overcharge.description: Deals 25% more damage to Paralysed foes.

pikachu-volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
pikachu-volt-switch.description: New skill: zaps a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55), then breaks free of engagement.

pikachu-point-blank-spark.name: Point-Blank Spark
pikachu-point-blank-spark.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

pikachu-lingering-shock.name: Lingering Shock
pikachu-lingering-shock.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

pikachu-wild-charge.name: Wild Charge
pikachu-wild-charge.description: New skill: a crackling charge into a foe (Power 90) that engages it.

pikachu-swift.name: Swift
pikachu-swift.description: New skill: star-shaped rays on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 80).

pikachu-lightning-reflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
pikachu-lightning-reflexes.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

pikachu-spark-battery.name: Spark Battery
pikachu-spark-battery.description: Each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

pikachu-slam.name: Slam
pikachu-slam.description: New skill: slams its tail into a foe (Power 90).

pikachu-zap-cannon.name: Zap Cannon
pikachu-zap-cannon.description: New skill: an electric cannon blast at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

pikachu-light-ball.name: Light Ball
pikachu-light-ball.description: Holds a glowing orb only a Pikachu can use: deals 10% more damage.

pikachu-lightning-speed.name: Lightning Speed
pikachu-lightning-speed.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

pikachu-thunderstruck.name: Thunderstruck
pikachu-thunderstruck.description: Capstone. Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP; a knockout resets its skill cooldowns.

pikachu-partner-spark.name: Partner Spark
pikachu-partner-spark.description: Capstone. Its Bond skills cost 1 less; its damaging hits on adjacent foes Paralyse them 1 turn.

pikachu-growl.name: Growl
pikachu-growl.description: New skill: a cute growl leaves an adjacent foe Weakened for 2 turns.
